description: Nonzero test floor per Go module (Spec 19 R19-12, R19-10). CI discovers test functions via 'go test -list' and fails when a module reports fewer than min_tests. Floors sit just below the current discovery count so legitimate refactors do not break CI, while deleting a module's tests or a broken module discovery is a hard failure. Module discovery is enforced fail-closed by scripts/check_go_modules.py: every go.mod in the repository MUST have a row here (and every row MUST name an existing module), so a new module cannot escape test/build/floor CI.

modules.applicability: required always: the MCP/guardrail server binary and its security matrix
required always: the shipped team CLI
required when present: illustrative Go config demo; tests exist (11 discovered), so it is tested, not SKIP
